args.summary:
Model built and all L1/L2/L3 checks passed.

Structure: cast-in-place 4-span continuous unit (32+45+45+32 m bearing centre-lines), modelled as a 2D spine beam (MR-01) on piers (continuous_on_piers, MR-05), pier columns modeled per MR-06.

Girder: single-cell cast-in-place box, C50 prestressed concrete. Integrated section A=6.885 m², I=4.559 m⁴ (MR-02). Ec=34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5). Owner-specified γ=26.5 kN/m³ (MR-00 override) giving w=182.45 kN/m, m=18.599 t/m (MR-07).

Supports (two bearings per line, MR-04):
- Abutments 0 & 4: PTFE sliding elastomeric 400×500, 5×11 mm → S=10.101, Kv=3.142e6 kN/m, Kh=0 (long. free).
- Piers 1 & 3: PTFE sliding elastomeric 550×650, 6×11 mm → S=13.542, Kv=7.175e6 kN/m, Kh=0 (long. free).
- Pier 2: plain fixed elastomeric 600×700, 7×11 mm → S=14.685, Kv=8.029e6 kN/m, Kh=10 909 kN/m (long. spring).
All per JTG 3362-2018 8.7 with default Ge=1.0 MPa.

Piers: twin 1.4 m C40 columns (n=2 merged): A=3.079 m², I=0.3771 m⁴, Ec=32500 MPa; heights 6/10/19 m, fixed at base.

Live load (JTG D60-2015): Class I, 3 design lanes (xi=0.78), qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=324/350/350/324 kN per span. Fundamental frequency f1=2.686 Hz → impact factor μ=0.159 (4.3.2).

Key results: first 3 vertical frequencies 2.686 / 3.733 / 5.413 Hz; self-weight support reactions ~2076/7739/8476/7721/2086 kN; max lane positive moment 11 420 kNm, max lane negative moment −9501 kNm.
